{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(trial)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {trial['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(trial) - trial['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sample_seq > 1 (re-tested patients)
duplicates = trial[trial['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {duplicates['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Re-tested patient count: {duplicates['patient_id'].nunique()} (expected 24 from doc)")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(trial['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check arm and severity distribution
print("\nArm vs Severity cross-tab:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial['arm'], trial['severity']))"}
